description: When the AMT base (Form 6251 line 12) is smaller than net capital gain plus qualified dividends, the whole base is taxed at the capital gain rates (line 22 = min(line 12, line 13)). MFJ 2025: wages $90,000, qualified dividends $150,000. Taxable income $208,500, worksheet line 5 $58,500. AMTI $240,000 − exemption $137,000 = $103,000. Line 17 $0; line 21 $96,700 − $58,500 = $38,200 at 0%; line 24 $64,800; line 29 $600,050 − $96,700 = $503,350; line 30 $64,800 × 15% = $9,720; line 33 $0. Line 38 $9,720 < line 39 26% × $103,000 = $26,780 → TMT $9,720.
